title: Service IA Restructure + CPU Temperature + Interface Label Consistency
acceptance_criteria: Global interface display uses Description (ethX) when description is available, excluding interface-description edit surfaces.
IPsec site-to-site wizard dialog is wide enough for readable proposal fields.
System Information dashboard card shows CPU temperature when available from VyOS.
Services are promoted in navigation with direct links to per-service views.
System Services page supports deep-linking via query tab values.
DNS Resolver/DDNS/DHCP Relay navigation targets exist as placeholders pending full implementation.
assumptions: VyOS does not expose FreeBSD powerd controls in current service/API surface.
CPU temperature is best-effort and may be unavailable depending on hardware/virtualization.
Placeholder pages for DNS Resolver/DDNS/DHCP Relay are acceptable for initial IA rollout.

Implemented service IA updates, CPU temp display, interface label consistency, and IPsec wizard readability fixes.
Validated parser behavior and reran backend + frontend checks.
Browser smoke remains blocked on missing Playwright host dependencies.
Run focused review for IA assumptions and placeholder scope.
Prepare handoff notes once reviewer sign-off and optional runtime smoke rerun are complete.
